'''Salky hounds''' were genetically-modified [[Kath hound/Legends|kath hounds]] bred by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] biological engineers for use as a trained security beast. They were bred from numerous different galactic specimens, resulting in sharp claws, keen senses, impressive jaw strength, and an aggressive demeanor. While effective, the Salky hounds were brutal and difficult to control. They would break handler control and attack targets with lethal force, resulting in several dozen deaths before the military recalled the hounds. The creatures were then sold on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] by their creators. Though they were banned on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], rumors persisted that they have been purchased on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
